newsitem.title: USA: Heritage Financial sets 3-for-2 stock split.
newsitem.headline: Heritage Financial sets 3-for-2 stock split.

text.p: Heritage Financial Services Inc said Wednesday its board declared a three-for-two stock split payable Jue 13 to shareholders of record on May 27.
The company said the split will increase its issued shares to about 12,128,357 from 8,085,571 shares.
The company said the board also voted to eliminate the par value of common shares.
The company said shareholders of record will receive an additional common share for every two shares owned as a result of the split.
Shareholders entitled to fractional shares will receive cash instead of fractional shares.
The company said the split should enhance its shares' liquidity while making it more affordable to individual investors.
The company said it is planned that future quarterly dividends will be paid at a rate of $0.10 per share on the new number of shares outstanding.
